query:
SELECT eventType, COUNT(*) as count FROM funnel_events GROUP BY eventType ORDER BY count DESC;

SELECT lastQuestionReached, COUNT(*) as count FROM funnel_events WHERE lastQuestionReached IS NOT NULL GROUP BY lastQuestionReached ORDER BY lastQuestionReached;
